messages:
maria: Heads-up: halcyon-liteq canary showing ~0.9% funcall parse failures on schema_v2 during streaming. Majority look like trailing-comma / partial-array splits.
jin: Logs? any sample payloads?
maria: sample chunked output pasted: 
```json
{"action":"charge","amount":100,}
```
The trailing comma ends up in the earlier chunk so the parser sees a broken object.
sam: Oof. That smells like streaming cut at kv-cache/batch boundary. Is this int8 path only?
luis: I ran the non-quant mirror — no spike there. Seems correlated with liteq codegen/kernel path.
eval-bot: Canary metrics — funcall_parse_errors=0.009 (0.9%), regen_retries=0.004, success_after_repair=0.007. Detailed examples landing in /tmp/halcyon-canary-examples/ (k=24).
alex: Quick mitigation idea: add a post-stream sanitizer that strips trailing commas and attempts simple join heuristics for split arrays/objects. Low-cost and reversible behind a header flag. Alternative is upping parse retry budget + a json-repair heuristic.
maria: @alex +1. Can we scope the sanitizer behind an opt-in header so we can enable for 5% traffic? I'll want conservative FP monitoring.
jin: I'll prepare a patch: feature flag header X-Experiment: halcyon-json-heal; sanitizer will emit a repair_reason tag and example snapshots to s3://redwood-dev/halcyon-json-heal/.
sam: Please add a metric for false_positive_repairs (cases where sanitizer changed output shape) and repair_latency.
luis: Also adding a small fuzz harness that simulates chunk splits at random byte offsets (esp around arrays) would help validate no regressions. I can wire that into CI smoke.
maria: Plan: 1) deploy sanitizer to canary 5% with header opt-in and verbose logging; 2) run 1h dogfood with curated prompt set; 3) evaluate residual parse error <0.3% and FP<0.1% -> escalate to 20%. If FP or correctness issues surface, rollback. I'll open a PR and assign reviews.
alex: If we see improvement, follow-up should include a small unit test set added to model onboarding checklist for liteq quant paths.
maria: Thanks team — I'll kick off the PR and post links here when ready. :thumbsup:
